verdict.rationale: Salesforce ships an official CLI (sf) with scriptable commands (org create scratch, data query, apex run test, agent create) that can be installed via npm and run headlessly, enabling CI automation for org/dev workflows, plus an official MCP server for agentic tooling. However, Sales Cloud itself is primarily a SaaS UI product, and no CI-specific documentation, pipelines, or headless automation examples for the core sales application are shown—evidence is CLI/dev-tooling focused rather than confirming full headless operation of Sales Cloud features.
